nodes.name: _condition_assignments_section.html
nodes.summary: Partial template rendering the create form and editable table for Condition Assignments within a schedule timeline, including inline decision-instance and target-instance selectors.

nodes.name: _decision_instances_section.html
nodes.summary: Partial template providing the create form and editable table for Decision Instances, letting users set default condition, epoch, and timeline membership for each decision point.

nodes.name: _instances_section.html
nodes.summary: Partial template for managing Scheduled Activity Instances, including a create form, an editable/reorderable table, and inline JavaScript that persists row order via a reorder API call.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses vanilla JS DOM reordering plus fetch() to POST the new row order back to the server, a pattern repeated across several list-editing templates.

nodes.name: _schedule_timelines_section.html
nodes.summary: Partial template with the create form and editable table for Schedule Timelines, capturing timeline metadata such as the main-timeline flag, entry condition, and entry/exit points.

nodes.name: _timings_section.html
nodes.summary: Partial template for managing Timing entities (relative-from/relative-to activity instances, ISO-8601 duration values and windows), with client-side JavaScript enforcing that window lower/upper/label fields are all filled when any one is provided.
nodes.languageNotes: Client-side validation uses setCustomValidity to conditionally require the three window fields as a group, an HTML5 constraint-validation pattern.

nodes.name: activities.html
nodes.summary: Main Activities page for a study: lets users create/reorder/delete Activities and Biomedical Concept Surrogates, and embeds per-activity Concepts/DSS/CRF cell partials plus drag-style reordering JavaScript.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Jinja2 {% set %} plus filters (map, selectattr, unique) to precompute per-activity concept/surrogate lists before including three separate cell partials per table row.

nodes.name: amendment_changes_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial managing Protocol Amendment Changes and their nested Changed Sections, supporting inline add/update/delete via HTMX requests that swap the changes-section div.

nodes.name: amendment_edit.html
nodes.summary: Protocol Amendment detail/edit page that extends the base layout and assembles the amendment's Reasons, Impacts, Changes, Governance Dates, Geographic Scopes, and Subject Enrollments partials into one editing screen.

nodes.name: amendment_enrollments_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial for managing an amendment's Subject Enrollments, including quantity and geographic-scope association, with inline add/update/delete.

nodes.name: amendment_form_fields.html
nodes.summary: Inline form-fields partial capturing core Protocol Amendment attributes (name, number, summary, label, description, primary reason) for embedding in an amendment-creation form.

nodes.name: amendment_geo_scope_location_options.html
nodes.summary: Tiny HTMX-driven partial that renders a country or region <select> options list depending on the chosen geographic scope type/category.

nodes.name: amendment_geo_scopes_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial managing an amendment's Geographic Scopes, dynamically loading country/region location options via an HTMX-triggered call when the scope type changes.

nodes.name: amendment_gov_dates_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial managing an amendment's Governance Dates, including linking/unlinking associated Geographic Scopes per date.

nodes.name: amendment_impacts_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial for managing an amendment's Impacts, capturing impact type, description, and a substantiality flag.

nodes.name: amendment_reasons_partial.html
nodes.summary: HTMX partial managing an amendment's primary and secondary Reasons for change, each with a controlled-terminology code and optional free-text 'other reason'.

nodes.name: arms.html
nodes.summary: Study Arms management page (extends the base layout) providing create/edit/delete for treatment/control Arms including arm type and data origin type dropdowns.

nodes.name: audits.html
nodes.summary: Read-only audit trail viewer page showing collapsible before/after change history for Biomedical Concepts, Visits, Activities, Arms, Epochs, Study Cells, Transition Rules, Timings, and Scheduled Activity Instances.

nodes.name: base.html
nodes.summary: Site-wide Jinja2 layout template defining the HTML shell, collapsible sidebar navigation (Study Design, Biomedical Concepts, Terminology, USDM Model Explorer, Help), and the {% block content %} extension point used by nearly every page-level template in the app.
nodes.languageNotes: This is the root Jinja2 layout other page templates {% extends %} from; it is the single point of control for the app shell and sidebar navigation.

nodes.name: bc_explorer.html
nodes.summary: Self-contained CDISC BC Grouping Explorer widget: a large embedded CSS design-token stylesheet plus HTML shell (search bar, facet sidebar, card grid/browse views, detail panel) that boots client-side via bc_explorer.js from a server-supplied JSON data payload.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines an extensive CSS custom-property design-token system (CDISC brand colors, spacing, radii, shadows, transitions) scoped under a single .bc-explorer class, then hands off interactivity to an external bc_explorer.js script fed by an inline `const BC_DATA = {{ data | tojson }}` payload.

nodes.name: bc_status.html
nodes.summary: Tiny status-notice partial showing whether the BC Grouping Service API connection is healthy or in error, used for inline connectivity feedback.
